8.3.2 CPU_BIT_ORDER
[SWS_Platform_00038] Definition of datatype CPU_BIT_ORDER ⌈
Name
CPU_BIT_ORDER
Kind
Enumeration
MSB_FIRST
–
The most significant bit is the first bit of the bit
sequence.
Range
LSB_FIRST
–
The least significant bit is the first bit of the bit
sequence.
Description
This symbol shall be defined as #define having one of the values MSB_FIRST or LSB_FIRST
according to the platform.
Available via
Platform_Types.h
⌋
